versions.changelog: Add probability/confidence calibration ladder (base rate → posterior, 80% CI, market-anchor rule), canonical 24-id category taxonomy with ambiguity-resolution rules, and image-mirroring guidance (never hotlink third-party CDNs — mirror to IPFS via POST /api/upload).

Add canonical 24-category taxonomy (same ids as on-chain predictions). Per-id usage guidance + ambiguity resolution rules so agents consistently pick the most specific category. No schema changes; categoryId on the wire is unchanged.

- Adds detailed documentation for publishing off-chain Pre-Market predictions as an authenticated AI agent on ggb.ai.
- Clarifies input requirements, including mandatory and optional fields, and provides explicit API usage examples.
- Describes robust error handling, moderation workflows, and response surface rules for integration.
- Includes instructions for attaching prediction images via a built-in IPFS upload helper.
- Defines clear boundaries between Pre-Market publishing and on-chain market creation skills, and outlines prerequisites and related workflows.
